method: Read-only source/math review and stdlib-only modifications of the authored synthetic test_scorer.fixtures() receipts in memory. No benchmark inputs or actual model/native results were read or generated.
synthetic_baseline: checks_passed=true, engineering_qualified=true on the deliberately invented pure engineering receipt fixture

findings.demonstration: Set raw.execution to invented outer fixture receipt, omit separately supplied execution argument. evaluate(plan,raw,None) still returns checks_passed=true and engineering_qualified=true.
findings.reason: Worker-supplied raw data can self-certify the separately required outer terminal cleanup/resource evidence.
findings.requested_fix: Require an independently supplied execution argument and mandatory CLI --execution; never fall back to raw.execution.

findings.demonstration: Replace all offsets in all six synthetic rows with [0,0], keeping literal source/feed equality and other declared flags. The scorer still qualifies.
findings.reason: Bounded and monotonic offsets alone do not prove coverage of the complete direct original premise/hypothesis.
findings.requested_fix: Require source-offset coverage of every non-whitespace character in each complete literal source segment, with the special-token offsets still zero. Do not invent fixed token IDs.

findings.demonstration: Keep raw_scores_available=false but add scores=[NaN,NaN,NaN] to every actual-looking synthetic query. The scorer still qualifies; score fields are ignored.
findings.reason: An availability flag can suppress finite checking of native fields that are already exposed in the raw query receipts.
findings.requested_fix: Require a literal boolean matching consistent score-field presence across every query, and validate every exposed score as finite.

findings.demonstration: Delete train, calibration, datasets and confirmation from the synthetic plan. The scorer still qualifies because absent roles are falsy.
findings.reason: Missing role declarations are accepted as empty declarations.
findings.requested_fix: Require each frozen role field explicitly equal to an empty list.

additional_source_observation.observation: The reviewed scorer validates the outer receipt internally but does not compare an outer plan SHA or worker/helper PIDs with current raw worker provenance. Main binds raw.plan_sha256 only.
additional_source_observation.recommendation: Where worker schema emits actual process IDs, require current plan SHA and worker PID/PGID/helper PID agreement between raw and independent outer receipt, so a stale unrelated cleanup receipt cannot certify a different raw run.

negative_control: A synthetic infinite native search latency was correctly rejected as an invalid finite-number receipt.
next_step: Parent will preserve reviewed bytes and fix source/test gaps before the new source freeze. This report is append-only; final corrected-source review must use a new artifact.
